mathematical_result: Complete independent proof of the literal complex weighted-bounded support-separation theorem and its coordinate-tail classification, with a separately formalized universal analytic core.

hypotheses.coefficients: Nonzero complex bilateral sequences b,c; only b/w and c*w bounded.
hypotheses.weight: Positive decreasing w, w_0=1 after normalization, half-line log convexity/concavity.
hypotheses.growth: log(w_(-n))/n^2 and -log(w_n)/n^2 tend to the same a>log(3).
hypotheses.correlations: sum_(j in Z) b_j*c_(j-r)=0 for EVERY positive integer r; absolute convergence is proved.

conclusion.support: Finite t=max supp b and h=min supp c, with t<=h.
conclusion.classification: All closed right-translation invariant subspaces of ell^2(w) are exactly the coordinate tails, including zero and whole space.
conclusion.quantitative: Along cofinal matched contacts, liminf |correlation(m+p)|/|b_p*c_(-m)| >= 1-2/(exp(lambda)-1)>0 for log(3)<lambda<a.

formal.remaining_application_verification: Independent reading of the complete proof in report.md; not a claim of full-theorem kernel closure.

jacobian.scope: Exact central-margin algebra only; no infinite-sequence conclusion is inferred from this operation.
